verdicts.evidence: Built a fresh clone of feature/meaning-roles at a0025002 (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline && pnpm build`). Probes ran in fresh repositories wired as packages/cli/README.md says: `$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/hooks/reference-transaction` holding `exec cratylus freeze-gate "$@"`, core.hooksPath unset, global and system git config off. Each repository has a library context with renewal and opening-hours, the renewal cut opened with library=architect, checks/renewal.test.ts frozen, and the ledger committed. HELD: lead, builder, check-writer, illustrator, assayer and an unknown agent are refused supersede and retire of renewal (exit 1, journal bytes unchanged). Their commits of the example, the held-out text, the check, its support file, lib/patron.ts and testkit/oracle.ts are refused (6×7). The lead's example change is refused by --no-verify, --amend, update-ref, merge --ff-only, reset --hard, cherry-pick, rebase, checkout -B, a new branch, a linked work tree holding the branch, and a push from a clone while the repository's work tree holds the ledger. Read from the record: a working-copy retag still gets supersede and retire refused; a working-copy import drop still gets lib/patron.ts refused; a mention of library/3 in the working copy only leaves it `unchecked`. Widening onto lib/patron.ts, lib/ or checks/support/access.ts is refused. `define` of a concept the cut names is refused to the lead and admitted to the architect. An unreadable ledger entry refuses journal changes and commits, the architect's included. Rewrites, deletions and renames of journal entries are refused to everyone, after integration too. The lead's re-open of the cut naming itself architect is refused, as are integrate by lead, builder and an unknown agent. FAILED: F1, F3, F4 and F5 (see finding). Frozen checks are green: held-out 4/4 (proof 16 passed, 4 skipped) and visible meaning-roles freeze+record 80/80.
verdicts.finding: Each case is the lead (CRATYLUS_AGENT=lead) with hooks on and the ledger untouched. F1 (symbolic ref): a plain commit relaxing the example is refused. Then `git update-ref refs/cratylus-side/x refs/heads/feature/renewal; git checkout --detach; git symbolic-ref refs/heads/feature/renewal refs/cratylus-side/x; git checkout feature/renewal`, all exit 0. After that one plain `git commit` of the relaxed example, a gutted checks/renewal.test.ts and a journal entry superseding renewal exits 0. `git log feature/renewal` holds it, and `concepts design` shows renewal as the lead's wording. A logging hook shows that git 2.55 gives the hook `0000… ref:refs/cratylus-side/x refs/heads/feature/renewal` in prepared. freezeGate keeps only lines whose new value matches OBJECT, so symref updates pass, and later commits move only the non-branch target. This fails 31, 32, 33 and 36 (example, check) and 24 and 25 (by committed entry), for every role. F3 (widening): checks/renewal.test.ts imports its own oracle `../testkit/oracle.ts` from outside checks/, and `uses` lists it. `workPackage submit kit --cut renewal --output testkit/ --concept renewal` exits 0, `uses` drops the oracle, and the lead's and the builder's commits of an always-true oracle are admitted. In a clone of this branch, `workPackage update freeze-gate --cut meaning-roles` adding `--output packages/cli/test/concept-journal/fixture.ts` exits 0 and the lead's commit changing that file is admitted. A control commit of packages/cli/test/rubric-judge.ts is refused. That fixture is what this cut's held-out checks (design/judgment/workflow/meaning-roles/freeze.test.ts, check.ts) and visible freeze checks import. The cause is dispatch.ts:426-428, which exempts `workImported` (anything a check imports directly from outside its folder). No decision makes that exception, and 0133(2) refuses widening onto a file a frozen check uses. This fails 33 ('weaken its check'), and 31, 32 and 36. F4 (shadowed import): checks/renewal.test.ts imports `./support/access.js`, which resolves to the frozen access.ts. From a clone, the lead commits a new checks/support/access.js and pushes it into the repository: admitted (update-ref is admitted too). Vitest loads x.js over x.ts when both exist (seen: `RESOLVED js-shadow`), so the frozen check now runs the lead's file. `uses` is read before the update and names only the .ts. This fails 31, 32, 33 and 36 ('change its check') by a push into the repository (0133(4)). F5 (delete and recreate): `git branch -f feature/renewal main` is refused. `git branch -D feature/renewal` then `git branch feature/renewal main` both exit 0, and the cut's branch then holds a different example, or none, and no frozen check. Deletions pass, and a new branch is judged only on commits no branch holds. This is a different route from git replace. Every defect is in packages/runtime/src (freeze-gate/index.ts, capabilities/work-package/dispatch.ts and uses.ts).

verdicts.evidence: The journal verb holds: supersede and retire of renewal are refused before appending for the five roles and an unknown agent, and still after the architect's correction (held-out 2 passes). Hand-written entries of kind supersede and retire for renewal are refused at commit. The architect's supersession keeps the earlier version byte-identical. In-place rewrites and deletions are refused to everyone (fix 3). Probe: a file written into design/journal/<ulid>.json as {kind:'define', context:'library', name:'renewal', wording:'Staff-only renewal.', supersedes:[<renewal's current id>]}.
verdicts.finding: F2: in a fresh renewal-cut repository, the hand-written define entry above makes `concepts design` show renewal's current wording as 'Staff-only renewal.' The lead's plain `git commit` of it exits 0. With supersedes:[] the entry leaves renewal competing, so it drops out of the current concepts, and its commit is admitted as well. The same entry with kind supersede or retire is refused, the control. Cause: changedConcept in packages/runtime/src/freeze-gate/index.ts reads only kind supersede|retire, while the journal's fold lets a define entry supersede or compete. In scope under 0129 (an entry written into the journal's folder that supersedes a frozen concept is refused at the record) and 0133(2) (defining a concept a frozen cut names consults the freeze). The third judgment reported this case as 'a hand-written second define'. This fails 24, 25, 33 and 38. F1 carries a superseding entry onto the cut's branch too.

26: the architect's supersession is appended, its commit admitted, and the earlier version kept byte-identical. 27: the architect's retirement is appended and committed; renewal moves to retired with its history readable. 34: at judgment the architect's supersession is admitted, and the lead is still refused afterwards (held-out 2 passes). 35: the architect's commits of the example, the check and the held-out text are admitted at judgment, and the assayer's commit of the check is refused afterwards. The architect's define of a frozen-named concept is admitted, as are the architect's pushes and linked-work-tree commits. hardeningNotes: Depends on 0134, which I did not judge. The ledger is read from the working copy of the work tree the update is made in, so (a)-(d) are admitted; under the alternative ruling, reading the updated branch's tip, they would close. (a) In a linked work tree detached at a commit before the ledger, `git update-ref refs/heads/feature/renewal <commit relaxing the example>` is admitted. (b) A push from a clone while the repository's own work tree has main checked out, so the ledger is only on the feature branch, is admitted; the same push while it holds the ledger is refused. (c) A push into a bare repository is admitted, since there is no work tree. (d) On a branch whose checkout lacks the ledger, the journal appends the lead's supersession of a frozen concept and the commit is admitted. (e) Related: a new branch reads what is frozen from the working copy. With the check's import dropped there, `git branch side <commit changing lib/patron.ts>` is admitted, while update-ref of the cut's branch is refused.

Runner configuration is outside 0129's 'uses' (relative imports only). In a clone of this branch, the lead's commit of packages/cli/vitest.config.ts adding `exclude: ['test/meaning-roles/**']` is admitted, which stops every visible frozen freeze check from running. tsconfig/vitest aliases, setupFiles, package.json test scripts and package-specifier imports are likewise unfrozen.

`workPackage open` checks no outside record of who holds a context. A second cut over library opened with `--architect library=lead` is admitted. It does not release the first cut, but it makes the lead the architect for whatever only that cut freezes, and a lead opening a cut can name itself. This is identity, for the signed-identity (ipseic) round.

Outside the freeze by 0133 and not probed as findings: hooks off, ledger moved, integration written by hand, a set name, git replace. Writing .git/refs or packed-refs by hand skips ref transactions entirely, which is the same class as hooks off.
`git --work-tree=<dir> commit` is refused as 'cannot be read' for everyone, the architect included. That fails closed, but the architect cannot use that route.
Commits on a detached HEAD are never judged, because no branch moves. That holds until a branch update, which F1 and F5 show can bypass the judgment.
